messages:
sam_cooper: FYI opening a billing escalation for ACME — customer reports SDK estimator ~1.2k tokens but invoice shows ~1.9k (case ACME-472). can someone triage?

maria_support: Thanks, grabbing repro now. customer attached curl + payload and a short explanation. pasting minimal repro so eng can repro locally.

sam_cooper: ```curl -s -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions\" \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-lite","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are helpful."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following long doc..."}],"functions":[{"name":"lookup_db","arguments":"{}"}],"stream":false}'\\n```

maria_support: Their client-side estimator (JS SDK) tokenises only the user+assistant messages and doesn't account for server-injected system/tool prompts or the serialized function-call payloads. invoice/usage shows usage: prompt_tokens:1200, completion_tokens:700, total:1900. SDK estimate returned ~1200 total.

ryan_engineer: two likely causes: 1) we inject orchestration/system prompts (e.g., tool shim + routing hints) on the server that the client never sees, 2) function call serialization + returned tool output is tokenized and billed on server. need request id/trace to confirm. also double-check tokenizer model used by SDK vs metering (cl100k_base vs cl100k_base-v2 can shift counts).

sam_cooper: trace id: 6a1f-zz-9987. invoice ref INV-2026-03-15-ACME.

evan_sre: pulled the trace. server-side injected message present: role=system content=\"tool-inject:db_lookup_prompt_v2\" (~450 tokens after tokenization). also the function call produced a synchronous tool response that we append to the completion for downstream steps (+~200 tokens). combined explains the ~700 token delta. logs snippet: 
```
TRACE 6a1f-zz-9987: injected_system_prompt_len=450; function_response_len=203; meter_model=cl100k_base; total_billed_prompt=1200; total_billed_completion=700
```

maria_support: good find. action items: 1) inform customer why invoice > SDK estimate (server-side injections + function payloads), 2) offer credit for unexpected month, 3) update SDK docs to warn about server-side injections and add an opt-in to include those counts in local estimator. cc @ryan_engineer for SDK changes.

ryan_engineer: I'll add an estimator flag (includeServerInjected = true) in the JS SDK to optionally fetch metering-overhead metadata from the control plane and compute a closer local estimate. will also add a short note in the README about function-call and injected-system overhead. plan: patch in next minor (v1.4.2).

metering_bot: NOTE: metering computes tokens from the serialized wire proto + tokenization with cl100k_base (internal doc: https://redwood.internal/metering/overheads). server-side injection and proto wrappers are billed because they're part of the executed prompt/completion.

billing_bot: INV-2026-03-15-ACME shows adjustment pending: 1x pro-rated credit applied to customer's March invoice. case ACME-472 flagged as resolved.

maria_support: I replied to the customer explaining the injected prompts and function-output billing, included trace id, attached curl repro, and offered the credit. customer accepted and appreciated the explanation. closing the loop.

sam_cooper: thanks everyone :thumbsup:\"
